about: Shops Ozi lists itself (ruling 65, 17 October 2026): well-known Medway high-street shops with their public addresses and typical hours. Read once by the start-up seed when there are no shops yet, and by the admin panel's 'Add the seed shops' button, which adds only the ones not there. Each is listed by Ozi, is not a partner, has no products of its own (the community catalogue applies), and shows 'Are you the owner? Claim this shop'. Names and addresses live here, never in code. Check the hours before launch: they are typical, not promised.
